summary: Default become methods don't open a new systemd session, so variables like XDG_RUNTIME_DIR aren't set and systemctl --user can fail; use become_method: machinectl to get a full pam_systemd session.
questions: Why does systemctl --user fail with become?
Why is XDG_RUNTIME_DIR empty under become?
How do I manage user systemd services with Ansible?

answer_card.title: become and systemd user sessions
answer_card.answer_md:
Default become methods don't open a new systemd session, so `pam_systemd` variables like `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` aren't set, and `systemctl --user` fails with "Failed to connect to bus: Permission denied".

Use:

```yaml
become_method: machinectl
```
